steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Letter for you! I'll leave it right here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm going into town this afternoon. Write down anything you want me to buy you before I go. Don't be late, because I won't wait!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Wow, that was fast! Thanks, Elysium!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Going into town again? For that thing that you have... what's it called? A transmitter?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: A transmitter-receiver—or transceiver!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: It's second-hand and the range is limited, but look at the case and the paint job! Don't you think it goes well with my outfit?

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: I'll never understand your tastes...

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Bring me back some cigarettes. Same brand as last time.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I also want one of those hair curlers everyone's been talking about. Could you get me one?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sure. The latest model, right? I'm on it.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey, sonny, what about my—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Now, who was it who asked me for cigarettes, then got caught by his family and got his allowance cut? As if I've forgotten.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not for another forty or fifty years, at least.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: The memory on you!

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Kids these days just can't let anything go...

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Ignore him. The doctor told him to stop smoking and he doesn't listen.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Here's the money for the hair curler. Thanks for that.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'll get you the best one there is.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Now, off I go.
How many years has it been since he left home?
Three? No, he was in Columbia that third year, then went north to Sami.
The Snowpriests stopped him when he tried to go further north, so he changed course and continued on his way.
A healthy man who knows some Arts can always find a job, as long as he's not too picky.
When he ran out of money, he would find work wherever he was and save a bit before heading out again. He has seen many sights along the way.
Some places were rich and prosperous, some poor and barren.
He did not stop at this town because there was something special about it.
He just wanted to rest.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: A new hair curler, and... well, I guess just a tiny little pack of cigarettes.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Still missing one component for the transceiver... hard to find an amplifier around here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey, am I imagining things...?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Or does the sky look a little ominous to me?

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: Oh, it's ominous all right.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You think so too? Great minds think alike!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: There's something special about you, isn't there? I would've believed it if you said you just robbed the shop. I'm guessing you didn't manage to sell too much today.

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: It's none of your concern. We're not an ordinary shop.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But you've got stuff to sell, don't you?

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: It's...

steps.name: 'Silent Lady'
steps.text: It's a prophylactic that we're distributing.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Prophylactic? Really? It's not for Oripathy, is it?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: They say the meds that really prevent Oripathy are so expensive that only the very rich can afford them, and the stuff you can get easily on the open market doesn't actually work.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But I think I've got a good eye for people, and you don't look like hucksters to me. Are you legit?

steps.name: 'Silent Lady'
steps.text: You heard?

steps.name: 'Silent Lady'
steps.text: You talk a lot.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Just being friendly. It's my secret to getting along.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Especially when dealing with people who look dangerous, or when I see something that maybe I shouldn't have, like drugs of unknown provenance—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Maybe if I'm talkative you'll take it easier on me when you beat me to a pulp. I'm sure the gentlemen over there will, at least.

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: No, I'll aim for the face.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Come now, say what you're really thinking, don't be shy.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But now I'm beginning to think you don't look like scammers or smugglers.

steps.name: 'Silent Lady'
steps.text: We're not.

steps.name: 'Silent Lady'
steps.text: We're a... pharmaceutical company. Our mission is to eliminate the Infected problem.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Eliminate the Infected, or eliminate the problem? Well, I that's what I would've asked, if I didn't have what I assume to be a deep trust in you.

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: I suggest you watch your mouth if you don't want it punched.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, no violence, please!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Alright, I've taken up enough of your time. I ought to be on my way.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Might be a good idea to put someone else on the front desk though, friends!

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: Just get lost! Mind your own business.

steps.name: 'Silent Lady'
steps.text: Catch.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whoa! What the... huh, medicine?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: For me? Oh, you're too kind.

steps.name: 'Silent Lady'
steps.text: Three thaler.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You're charging money? I mean, three thaler isn't that bad...

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: Captain...

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: He wasn't talking to himself, was he? Was he talking to you?

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: But... how could that be?

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: Sorry, sir, but we're out of that particular ampliﬁer.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Seriously? But you're my last hope!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Are you sure? You don't have one lying in a corner of a warehouse or something?

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: I've looked everywhere. Plus, we keep good records of all our transactions.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I know, I know.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: You've been here before. Still working on that machine you were talking about last time?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yes, the transceiver. I've been doing all the modifications myself.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I have very little experience with this stuff, but things have been going relatively smoothly, learning on the fly and doing it myself. I'm surprised that I'm learning so quickly!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm just looking for the right amplifier to take its performance up another level.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What do you think about me becoming a Messenger? My Arts would fit right in. I was born to be one, wasn't I?

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: Ha, becoming a Messenger is about more than just putting together a transmitter.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You've got to take exams, right? Don't worry, they used to call me Rey de los tests back home.

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: What does that mean?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: It means I'm really good at tests.

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: Let's get back on topic.

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: It's not a common model, but I could try to get one for you, if you can wait.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sure, I'll be around.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's it, then, I'll be back later—

steps.name: Radio Announcement
steps.text: Attention. Attention.

steps.name: Radio Announcement
steps.text: This is an emergency public service announcement.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Serious face there. Who's the letter from?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Quiet, give me a second...

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Yes! Good news!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: What's the good news?

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: I bet it's got something to do with Elysium. The signature on the letter looks like the Messenger that was reassigned to the city a while back.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: The Catastrophe Messenger!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Elysium's been here a while. He can't stay in that little attic of ours forever.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: So I wrote a letter and the Catastrophe Messenger said Elysium could move into his house.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Really? He'd be so gracious?

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Who are you talking about? What Catastrophe Messenger?

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Did we ever have one? Wasn't Elysium saying he could be the town's regular Messenger?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Well... we used to have a Catastrophe Messenger.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: The town gave him a house, hoping to entice him to stay.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: But you know those types, they won't stay in a backwater like this for long.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: I'm getting grumpy just thinking about it. See you later.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: ...Sigh.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Can't blame them, though. The big cities pay much more than we can. No way for us to stop them.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Hmph! Who cares! We have Elysium.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: He's given himself a codename. He says the first step to becoming a professional Messenger is having a cool codename. He seems serious about it.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I hope so!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Say, I'm getting a bad feeling...

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Hey! Everybody!

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Go outside! Look up at the sky!

a.text: Our Catastrophe Messenger predicts that a localized Catastrophe will take place southwest of the city in a few hours.
While the Catastrophe is not expected to present a threat to the city, citizens are advised to exercise caution when going outdoors for the next few days.
In particular, we strongly advise against traveling to the southwest until further notice.

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: My supply routes don't come through the southwest.

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: It shouldn't affect your thing—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Here's the deposit! I'll be back; just get that item for me!

steps.name: Hardware Shop Owner
steps.text: Hey! Where are you going?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: To race against a Catastrophe!
Going back now means taking a massive risk.
Elysium can't help but ask himself: Is he really that attached to the town?
Hard to say. Probably not so much that he should risk his life for it. He's only been there a few months.
But he also understands that he can't just stand by and watch, can't just wait for the storm to pass.
And there's no point in thinking about what he can't do.
He needs to focus on what he can do.

steps.name: Frightened Child
steps.text: Mom, I'm scared of that big cloud in the sky...

steps.name: Helpless Mother
steps.text: D-Don't be scared! We'll go and find dad!

steps.name: Panicked Woman
steps.text: Was that an earthquake?! What do we do?

steps.name: Injured Man
steps.text: Help! I'm trapped under this frame! I can't move my leg!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: I'm coming! Hang on!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Catastrophe! Catastrophe!

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: It was like this the last time! We need to run! As far and as fast as we can!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Aah!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whew...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That was a perfect rescue, wasn't it? A judge would've given that ten out of ten. What do you think?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Elysium! Y-You're hurt!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: What are you doing here? Didn't you go into town?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That? Just a scratch.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I heard through the grapevine that someone needed my help—alright, I came back because I heard on the radio that this area might get hit by a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: How's that? Pretty selfless, if I do say so myself.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Y-You fool! Idiot! Why did you come back?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wait, why are you yelling at me?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Save the jokes, now's not the time.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Tell everyone to get ready to move... this sort type of Catastrophe will be on top of you before you know it. We don't have much time!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: But where do we go?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Leave that to me.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm an expert at surviving in the wilderness.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Stay close to me! Don't get separated!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Originium levels in the atmosphere will increase sharply in the presence of a Catastrophe, and the wind might be carrying active Originium particles. Keep yourself covered, especially any wounds!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: But you just got hurt...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't worry, I have a secret weapon.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Well, how about that, those meds I got are gonna come in handy!)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Let's hope they're the real deal.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Just hold on!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We're almost... there!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Lock and bolt the door... alright, we'll be safe for now.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Is this an underground shelter?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yes, an abandoned one.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: I never knew about this place. How did you find it?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm rather adept at pathfinding. Let me tell you, I mapped this entire area with my own two feet.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: There's nothing here I don't know about, including shelters that have been abandoned for years.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Now, please, shower me in praise.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Huh? Oh... you're amazing, Elysium!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yup, keep going, I know you've got more in you!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Ahem... well, we definitely owe you one.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: So we should just wait? We left in such a hurry that we didn't have time to bring a lot of supplies... how long will we be in here?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Until the Catastrophe passes and things return to normal outside, at least.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sudden Catastrophes like this tend to go as quickly as they come.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: I don't want to think about what might have happened if you didn't come back.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But we should make a plan for future emergencies. This shelter is pretty old. It's taken a beating.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I wouldn't have picked it if there were crystal clusters growing from the ground, but fortunately that's not the case this time.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: There's just nothing we can do about Catastrophes...

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: If we had some sort of advance warning, at least...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't get too down on me, bro.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's exactly what I've been working on all this time.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: That's good news. What are you fiddling with?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Just some machines... imagine that I'm yelling out in a radius of a few klicks that 'We need help here!'

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: It might not be useful right now, but it never hurts to be prepared.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: The earth's shaking... how long is this gonna last?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Eek! What was that noise?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Sounds like something fell...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'll go take a look.
The Liberi passes through the crowd of townsfolk crammed into this dark shelter.
A panicking mother holds her child tightly in her arms. The elderly sit in a corner, like a row of wrinkled statues.
Elysium can hear the occasional sob. There seems to be fewer people here than he thought there would be. He tries not to think about it.
He looks at the source of the sound. Above them is the door that they came in from. A little bit of dirt drops in with every vibration.
He gets a bad feeling.
The Liberi extends his hand.
Then he stops, stunned.
The door has been blocked by fallen rocks and can no longer be opened.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: We can't get out?! How could this...

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't panic! Just a little hitch in the plan. We'll dig our way out.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Relax, everyone. We still have my transceiver, and I've already sent out a distress signal. All we have to do is wait.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Really? That's great!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (The range is limited without an amplifier, though...)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (I need to think of a way.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (I didn't manage to take the medicine either. Now my injured shoulder is starting to feel numb.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (We were in the ashring for a while. I had wrapped it in cloth, but that's not exactly enough.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Seriously? Just my luck...)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Well, maybe that's not so bad, given the situation...)

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Things seem to have calmed down.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Good news. It looks like the Catastrophe has passed.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: Any news?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not yet, but I'm happy to report that I've achieved a breakthrough in the transmission range! Help should be here soon now that the Catastrophe is over.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: I hope so...

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Your wound looks worse. What about the secret weapon of yours?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Er... well, it's not time to use it yet.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll use it when I have to. When I have to.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: How many layers of dirt are up there? We're not getting through!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: We can't hold out much longer without food and water. Are you hearing anything?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Settle down. We should save our strength if there's no way through.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: How are we supposed to settle down? You've been sending that signal for ages. With no response!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: No one's coming to help us! We're all gonna starve to death here!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We might be able to get help if we can contact a nearby nomadic city.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: That piece of junk doesn't have the range!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Right, which is where I come in.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Everybody, listen up.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Keep your distance from me.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Keep our distance? What do you mean?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well... I mean what I said.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Give me space. Don't come close.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: How many days have we been here?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I don't think I can hold on...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Just a bit longer!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: How long do we have to wait...?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I've got this! I'm beaming a transmission out there!

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: We're done for...

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: We were always doomed, whether we stayed up there or came down here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't... *cough*... say that...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Almost... almost... we made it this far...)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Come on, don't disappoint me, 'pharmaceutical company'...)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (The wound's swollen, maybe festering, and I'm hurting all over, like that time I got run over by that contraption in Rim Billiton... worse, actually.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (My Arts are getting more powerful, though it aches when I use them.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Is this how it feels to get Oripathy?)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Looks like I won't get to use those meds after all.)

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: What's that... sound...?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I got a response!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Response...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yes! A station heard me and responded!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You hear me? Hold on! Someone's coming!

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: It's here, right?

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: How the heck did that signal find us?

steps.name: Masked Man
steps.text: Is Rhodes Island so well-known already? We've only just gotten started.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Captain, we're reading vital signs below.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ready to dig.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Welcome... oh, it's you, Elysium.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Morning, folks. It's been a while! Nice to see that the rebuilding is going well.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Yeah... all thanks to you. We wouldn't have made it otherwise.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's great! I'm glad I worked so hard.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Just simple houses to protect us from the elements. Nothing complicated.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Where have you been?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Me? A bunch of nice people who don't look so nice dragged me away to treat my sickness. I've never seen a doctor so scary, I tell you.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Your sickness...

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Well, have a seat, er, I'll pour you a drink.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, there's no need for that, I'll be going in a moment.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I just wanted to come back and say goodbye, because I'm leaving.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Y-You're leaving? But you said...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, the Messenger thing? Well, er, sorry about that.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I guess I just want to see the world, you know? Like they say, don't put a fowlbeast in a cage... well, however the saying goes.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: But we haven't thanked you for saving our lives yet!

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Yeah. It's just a little sickness... it's no big deal.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: If you're leaving because you're Infected—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: It's okay, I hear you.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But people will get scared if there's an Infected living in town. They won't want to talk.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: We're not scared!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I know, I know. There's always a risk, though.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, don't give me that look. It's not so bad.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You remember Rhodes Island? The people who dug us out of that hole? I'm going with them.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: They're going to keep treating me. Things don't get any better than that!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Can they cure your sickness?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well... I don't know.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Will you come back?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Of course! I'll drop by when I get some free time.

steps.name: Strong Townsfolk
steps.text: Where are you going now?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, I'm not sure.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I guess I'll go with the Rhodes Islanders for a while. I think this is the beginning of a beautiful journey.
